Catalog number : I00058 Uniform title: Parārthapūjā Manuscript : IFP manuscript bundle RE31011 Description: RE31011 Parārthapūjā is a technical Śaiva manual written in Sanskrit and Tamil. It guides priests through Agamic temple rituals, traditional Hindu ceremonies performed for the welfare of the world.The process begins with the seeking of permission from the site guardian (Kṣetrapāla), followed by the performance of extensive purification rituals for the environment, materials, and mantras. A key technical aspect is the preparation of Pañcagavya and Pañcāmṛta using precise geometric grids called Koṣṭhas. This action is preceded by worshipping the Sun and Gaṇeśa.The core liturgy involves invoking Lord Śiva in the liṅga through a hierarchical ascent of five ritual seats (pañcāsana), using the prāsādamantra and specific mudras. The ceremony concludes with ritual bathing and the application of time-specific floral and cloth adornments, followed by final prayers for forgiveness to ensure the rite’s spiritual integrity.The manuscript is in a damaged condition. It measures 3.3 cm x 35.5 cm. (p.5b, l.1) śuklāmbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam । prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntaye ॥ (l.2) mahāgaṇādhipataye namaḥ । īśvara varṣam । āṣāḍha māsam । bhānuvāsaram ॥
(p.6a, l.1) கொசபேட்டை சுப்ரமணிய குருக்கள். (l.2) சிறகுன்றம் சுப்ரமணியன் எழுதிகக்காடுத்த (l.3) parārthapūjā prārambham ।
(p.6b, l.1) kṣetrapālasannidhau upāgamyā । dvārapūjāṃ vidhāyā(ya) । snānādyabhiṣekārccana naivedya dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । prārthayet । (l.2) svāmin sarvajaganān bhūmau rakṣārthaṃ kṣetrapālakā । śivapūjāvidhānārthaṃ mudrādaṇḍaṃ pradehime ॥ (l.3)ityaṅkuśa mudrayā mudrāyudhaṃ grihītvā śayanālayadvāramupāgamya । śivaśaktinayanonmīlanārthaṃ (l.4) dvārapārśve rudragaṇikā gītavādyaṃ vācayitvā dvārapūjane kavāṭodghāṭanaṃ kṛtvā । vighnatrayaṃ nivāryā । (l.5)antaḥ praviśyā । arghyodakenāstreṇa mañcāvrata tirodhānapaṭaṃ samprokṣyā । varmaṇābhyarcyā । mañcordhve nikṣipyā (p.7a, l.1) astreṇa mūrttiṃ nikṣipyā । prokṣyā nirmālyaṃ visṛjyā । pādahastaśudhyarthaṃ astreṇa jalaṃ datvā । snānārthaṃ mūlenārghyodakenā samprokṣya । (l.2) astreṇa gandhamālādibhirlaṅkṛtyā । mūlabrāhamāṅgamantraiḥ sampūjyā । naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । (l.3) śaktiṃ vinā devaṃ śibikāmāropyā । sarvavādyopacārai parijanai niṅgasannidhimupāgamyā । (l.4)tanmūrttiṃ puṣpeṇodbhavamudrayā liṅge samyojyā । yathā sthānemūrttiṃ samsthāpyā । pūjārthaṃ snapanamaṇṭape (l.5)kūrmāsanopari sthitvā । sthānaśuddhiṃ samācaret । arghyodakena samprokṣya tratālamātramastreṇa caturaśraṃ kṛtvā । (l.6)bhūmidevimāsanādibhiḥ āvāhanaṃ kṛtvā । dhyānam dvibhujāñca dvinetrāñca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitām । varābhayavarāndevīṃ sarvā*bharaṇabhūṣitām ।* (p.7b, l.1) iti dhyātvā । hṛdayāstreṇa sampūjyā । naivedyārghyaṃ datvā । evaṃ sthalaśuddhiḥ । śaṅkhājñarghyācamanīyya pādyapātrapuṣpānya (l.2)pātrāṇyāstreṇa prakṣālyā । hṛdayenasamsthāpyā । vilokyā । mṛtikṛtyā । vardhanyāṃ śṅkhapātre mūlenajalāmāpūryā(l.3) śivamstreṇa vardhanīṃ sampūjyā । brahmāṅgairabhyarcyābhimantryā । liṅgapadmamudrāṃ pradarśyā śaṅkhodakasya pañcaśuddhiṃ (l.4) vidhāyā । mūlenābhyarcyā । ekādaśavāraṃ daśabījenābhimantryā । dhenvastramahāmudrāṃ pradarśyā । dhūpadīpau datvā । (l.5) tajjalaidravyāṇi samprokṣyā viśeṣārghyapādyācamanīyya pātrāṇi sādhayet । teṣu uttamadravyāṇi nikṣipyā(l.6) arghyodakaṃ astrabrahmāṅgamantraiḥ abhyarcyā । pādyapātraṃ hṛdayenābhyarcyā । praṇavena saptavāraṃ abhimantryā । ācamanīyyārghyapātraṃ (p.8a, l.1) daśabi...bhyarcyā । tat savyābhimantryā । dhenumudrāṃ pradarśyā । dhūpadīpau datvā । iti dravyaśuddhiḥ । śivahastāvahanārthaṃ dakṣiṇakaratale (l.2)mūlenagandhapuṣpākṣataṃ nidhāyā । vāmahastena nirīkṣaṇādi amṛtikaraṇāntaṃ kṛtvā । dharmādyāsanamūrttimabhyarcyā । (l.3)mūlabrahmāṅgāni vinyasyā । jyotirūpaṃ dhyātvā । śivamantreṇa śirasinikṣipyā । hastadvayaṃ prāsādena divyadṛṣyyāvalokyā (l.4) śivahastaṃ bhāvayet । atha pañcagavyam । tat paścimabhāge śālibhiḥ hastamātraṃ caturaśraṃ vidhāyā । ajite vedāgramadhyara*vi savyakṛtāsu rekhā koṣṭhāni tatvasamavidhiṣu ।* (l.5) pañcakeṣu । tatrādya vidhimapabhāya dvitīya paṅtiṃ sajājya । pūrvaṃ bījottaranandasaṅkhyā । evamullikhyā । madhyapade । oṃ hāṃ śivatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । āgneyāṃ īśvaratatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । naiṛtyāṃ māyātatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ ।
(p.8b, l.1) pūrve sadāśivatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇe vidyātatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । uttare puruṣatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । paścime kālatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । (p.9a blank) (p.9b, l.1) vāyavye niyatitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । aiśānyāṃ prakṛtitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । evaṃ koṣṭhānāmabhyarcyā । navasūtreṇāveṣṭyā pūjyā hṛdaye prakṣālyā । astreṇa samprokṣyā varmaṇā dhūdīpārghyaṃ datvā । koṣṭhamadhye (l.2) pātrāṇi samsthāpyā । madhye oṃ hāṃ supratiṣṭhapātrāya namaḥ । pūrve oṃ hāṃ suśāntapātrāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇe oṃ hāṃ tejovat pātrāya namaḥ । (l.3) uttare oṃ hāṃ ratnodakapātrāya namaḥ । paścime oṃ hāṃ amṛtātmakapātrāya namaḥ । aiśānyāṃ oṃ hāṃ *avyaktapātrāya namaḥ ।* (l.4) āgnoyādi vāyavyāntaṃ amṛtātmaka pātrāya namaḥ । iti sampūjyā । gandhādibhiralaṅkṛtyā । madhyapātrasyapṛṣṭhamadhyāgradeśeṣu । (l.5) brahmaviṣṇurudramūrttīn sampūjyā । tasya pūrvādyuttarāntaṃ । gaṇapati ṣaṇnukhaṃ nandi mahākālān sampūjyā । vidikṣu caturvedān sampūjyā । (l.6) abhyarcyā । dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । āpyāyasve mantreṇa madhya pātre kṣīramāpūryā । pūrve - dadhikrāviṇṇeti - dadhi । dakṣiṇe - (p.10a, l.1) śukramaset - ghṛtamāpūryā । uttare - sāvitryā - gomūtram । paścime - gandhadvāreti - gomayam । aiśānyoḥ - devasyatveti - kuśodakam । (l.2) āgneyādivāyavyāntam । astreṇa tailaviṣṭhāmalaka dravyāṇi samsthāpyā । sakūrcca pallavaratnanālikerāṇi vinyasyā । (l.3) puṇyāhajalena samprokṣyā । kṣīrādikaśodakāntaṃ īśānassarvavidyānāmiti mantreṇa pañcapātreṣu(l.4) catustriṇiyugmekavāraṃ abhimantryā । āvāhyā । yathoktamudrāṃ pradarśyā । naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । anyapātrāṇi ṣaḍaṅgenābhyarcyā । (l.5)mudrāṃ pradarśyā । mūlabrahmāṅgavyāhṛti daśabījai sakṣīrādikuśodakāntaṃ tailādi rajanyāntaṃ kramamantreṇābhimantryā । (l.6)pūrvādipañcapātrasthita dravyaṃ yathā kramam । madhyapātre samyojyā mūlena aṣṭhottaraśataṃ japtvā । digbandhanāvakuṇṭhanaṃ vidhāya । (p.10b, l.1) mānasteketimantreṇa trivāraṃ nirmadhyayā । vāmadakṣiṇahastābhyāṃ nāsocchāreṇana nāsāgraṃ udhṛtyā । mūlamantreṇa samsthāpyā । arccayediti pañcagavyam ॥ (l.2)
atha pañcāmṛta tat paścime bhāge śālibhisthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā । madhyenavapadaṃ vidhāyā । āgneyādi(l.2)catuṣpadānityajet । madhye pade - oṃ hāṃ pṛthvitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । pūrve - oṃ hāṃ aptatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇe -(l.3) oṃ hāṃ vahnitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । paścime - oṃ hāṃ vāyutatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । uttare - oṃ hāṃ vyomatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ । (l.4) ityabhyarcyā । pātrāṇi tantunāveṣṭyā । astreṇa prakṣālyā । hṛdayenādhūpadīpayitvā । pātrāṇi koṣṭheṣu nidhāyā । (l.5) oṃ hāṃ bhāge gandhatatvapātrāya namaḥ । pūrve - rasatatvapātrāya namaḥ । yāmye - rūpatatvapātrāya namaḥ । paścime - sparśatatvapātrāya namaḥ । uttare - śabdatatvapātrāya namaḥ । (p.11a, l.1) iti sampūjyā ॥ madhye payaḥ । pūrve phalam । yāmye madhu,sarpirvā । praticyāṃ śarkarāṃ,gulaṃ vā । uttare ikṣusāraṃ nālikeraṃ (l.2)balilaṃ vā । brahmamantraissampūjyā pūrvavat brahmāṅgenābhimantryā । āvāhyā । pañcamudrāṃ pradarśyā । dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । (l.3) pūrvādi caturdikṣu pātrasthitaḥ dravyāṇi madhyapātre samyojyā । mūlenābhimantryā । digbandhanāvakuṇṭhanaṃ (l.4)vidhāyā । vaidikabrahmāṅgamantrābhyāṃ abhimantrayediti pañcāmṛtasnapanam । tat paścimabhāge droṇatrayavrihitaṇḍula (l.5) tiladhānyopari pañcatālamātram । caturaśraṃ padmamālikhyā । tadupari padmāsanamabhyarcyā । navakumbhān (l.6)vardhanivasūtreṇāveṣṭyā । hṛdayenāprakṣālyā । astreṇa dhūpayitvā । udakenāpūryā । sugandhadravyaṃ ratnakūrcāphallava nālikeraphala kusumādibhiḥ (p.11b, l.1) gandhākṣatavastreṇālaṅkṛtyāstreṇa padmoparisamsthāpya abhyarcyet । madhye śivāsanamūrttiṃ sampūjyā । āvāhyā । (l.2) sthāpanādi pañecamudrāṃ pradarśyā । vardhanyāṃ manonmanīṃ mantreṇāvāhyā । sthāpanādipadmayonimahāmudrāṃ pradarśyā । (l.3) pūrvādyaṣṭādidikṣu । ananteśādi śikhaṇḍyantamabhyarcyā । naivedyādidhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । mātṛkādi kalābhaṅgi vinyasediti (l.4) snapanam ।
atha saurapūjā indrāgnayormadhye īśāne śivāsūryamabhyarcayet । sūryāgre uttarābhimukho (l.5)praṇavāsanenārghyaṃ datvā । samsthāpyā । dvāradakṣiṇavāmapārśvayoḥ । daṇḍine namaḥ । piṅgalāya namaḥ । (l.6)gaṇapataye namaḥ । gurubhyo namaḥ । antargatvā āsane oṃ hāṃ prabhūtāsanāya namaḥ । garbhāvaraṇe naiṛtyāntaṃ īśānāntaṃ vimalāya namaḥ । sārāya namaḥ । purādhyāya namaḥ । (p.12a, l.1) paramasukhāya namaḥ । padmāya namaḥ । iti padmamudrāṃ pradarśyā । tasyamukhāgrādyaṣṭadikṣu । dīptāyai namaḥ । sūkṣmāyai namaḥ । jayāyai namaḥ । bhadrāyai namaḥ । (l.2) vibhūtiyai namaḥ । vimalāyai namaḥ । amoghāyai namaḥ । vidyutāyai namaḥ । sarvatomukhyai namaḥ । visphuramudrāṃ darśayitvā । (l.3) oṃ hāṃ arkkāsanāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ arkamūrttaye namaḥ । oṃ ghaṃ (khaṃ khaṣolkāya)ghaṣolkāya sūryamūrttaye namaḥ । oṃ haṃ hāṃ netrebhyo namaḥ । oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ (l.4)sahaśivasūryāya namaḥ । iti mantreṇāvāhyā । sthāpanādi pañcamudrāṃ pradarśya । dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । dhyānam ādityaṃ sarvakarttāraṃ *kalā dvādaśasamyutam ।* (l.5) padmahastadvayaṃ vande sarvalokaikasākṣiṇam ॥ - iti dhyātvā । gāyatrīṃ vinyasya । aṅgāni sampūjyā । (l.6) bimbaṃ janemanābhiṣicyā । punastailādi sarvadravyodakenābhiṣicyālaṅkṛtyā । mūlenābhyarcyā । padmavisphurayonimudrāṃ pradarśyā ।
(p.12b, l.1) tatpārśvayoḥ uṣāpratyuṣāmabhyarcyā । tasyavṛttāṣṭhadikṣu somādigrahān sampūjyā । tṛtīyāvaraṇe - daśalokapālān sampūjyā । naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā । (l.2) vāme oṃ hāṃ tejascaṇḍeśvaraṃ sampūjyā । punarmūlena mūrttiṃ hṛdayenyasyā । namaskāraṃ vidhāyā । iti sūryapūjā ॥ (l.3) atha gaṇeśa pūjā gaṇeśāgra maṇṭape saumyāsyopaviśyā । prāṇāyāmādi sakalīkṛtyā । ācamyā । vyāpakaṃ nyaset । o gaṃ sarveśvarāya namaḥ - iti śirasi । (l.4) oṃ gaṃ vighnahantre namaḥ - iti netre । oṃ gaṃ gajamukhāya namaḥ - kaṭyām । oṃ gaiṃ ākhuvāhanāya namaḥ - ūrvyoḥ । oṃ gauṃ vighneśvarāya namaḥ - jānvoḥ । (l.5) oṃ gaṃ gaṇeśvarāya namaḥ - iti pādayoḥ । punaḥ śiro-mukha-vakṣa-guhya-jānu-pādeṣu gaṇāntveti(l.6) pañcamantraiḥ sārdhyaṃ vinyasyā । ṣaḍhaṅgaṃ vidhāyā । iti vyāpakannyāsaḥ । athārghya,pādyācamanīyyapātrāṇi pūrvavat parikalpyā । puṇyādi snapanāntaṃ vidhāyā । (p.13a, l.1) dvāramastreṇa samprokṣyā ūrdhve - gaṇaṇapati sarasvati mahālakṣmīṃ sampūjyā । pārśvayoḥ - bhuvaṅga,pataṅga,kūśmāṇḍa,kumbhodarān namontaṃ (l.2)sampūjyā । mūlenārccitāmaṇivile padmāsanāntaṃ abhyarcyāṅgamityādi bījena ṣaḍaṅgasthāne vidhāya । mūlenāvāhyā gāyatri (l.3)mantraṃ mantraṃ vinyasyā । dvārapālān sampūjyā agre mahāsuramūṣikamabhyarcya । upacāraṃ vidhāyā । antargatvā । naiṛtyādīśānāntaṃ (l.4) vāsudeva sarasvatī mahālakṣmīsamṛddhi vijayāyiti । pāśāṅguśa trikhaṇḍa yoninamaskāra mudrāṃ pradarśyā । dhyānam । gajānanaṃ *triṇetrañcā kuṅkumābhaṃ caturbhujam ।* (l.5) pāśaṃ dantañca savye tu vāme tu aṅkuśalaḍḍukau ॥ - iti dhyātvā । abhyaṅgādi snānoktadravyodakena (l.6)abhiṣicya । vastradiralaṅkṛtya । pūrvavat sampūjyā । pārśvayoḥ siddhilakṣmīṃ vallabhābhyāṃ iti abhyarcyā । dvitīyāvaraṇe - gaṇeśamūrttin pūjayet । (p.13b, l.1) yogaje । vighneśaṃ mahākarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ mahodaram । ekadantaṃ mahākāyaṃ vināyakagaṇādhipam ॥ iti sampūjyā । tṛtīyāvaraṇe (l.2) cintyatantre bālo bhaktaśca vi(vī)raścā śaktissarvārtha siddhidaḥ । piṅgalo(cchi)ściṣṭharaktaścā kṣipro heramba eva cā ॥ (l.3) lakṣmījayanṛttastu ūrdhvo mahāgaṇastathā । haridro ṣoḍaśatrayostṛtīya prati pūjayet ॥ caturthāvaraṇe āgneyāṃ santānatarumūle (l.4)- sarasvatī sametāya brahmaṇe namaḥ । naiṛtyāṃ mandāratumūle - lakṣmī sametāya viṣṇave namaḥ । vāyavyāṃ kalpatarūmūle - (l.5)bhavānī sametāya maheśvarāya namaḥ । īsānyāṃ candanatarūmūle - ratyā sametāya kāmadevāya namaḥ । pañcāvaraṇe - (l.6)indrādilokapālān
